title: Final Audit, Handoff, and Controlled Research Continuation Loop
mission: Produce the complete implementation and results dossier, archive all artifacts, and define the next research loop if 0.45°C has not been achieved.
steps: Validate every task acceptance criterion and dependency.
Summarize proven, proxy, diagnostic, rejected and pending findings.
Report current best MAE by frame without cross-frame confusion.
Archive hashes, migrations, configs, models and commands.
If confirmed MAE > 0.45, invoke Research Director to propose a new pre-registered lane using accumulated evidence, while preserving remaining holdouts.
acceptance: Best score and uncertainty stated on exact frame
Next loop has no holdout leakage
failure: Any incomplete task remains explicit blocker; final report cannot mark system complete
